Name: Bird Feeders
Author: Sable17
Description:
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/nN6P06YB/title.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[size=5][center]Attract those cute little birds to your farm![/center][/size]
[color=#e69138][size=3][b]Bird Feeders[/b][/size][/color]
~ Sold mainly at[b] Robin's shop[/b], some (unusual-ish) ones at JojaMart.
~ [b]18[/b] different variations of Bird Feeders. [b]Most have seasonal changes[/b]!
     -Robin sells [b]different [/b]Bird Feeders in [b]each season[/b], so check back!
~ Place your Bird Feeder down on the [b]farm [/b]and add some [b]wild bird feed[/b]. Come back later and find little birds enjoying your farm and feed!
~ After [b]2 days[/b], they'll have eaten all the feed and left you a present.

~ [b]Note[/b]: Birds don't come to feed in the rain, or falling snow, and they'll bed down for the night after 7PM.

[color=#e69138][b][size=3]Wild Bird Feed[/size][/b][/color]
~ [b]5[/b] types of bird feed can be put in the Bird Feeders:
     -[b]Mixed Seeds[/b]
     -[b]Mixed Flower Seeds[/b]
     -[b]Wild Bird Feed [/b](Sold at Marnie's)
     -[b]Joja Wild Bird Feed[/b] (Sold at JojaMart)
     -[b]Premium Wild Bird Feed[/b] (Crafted. Recipe for it is sold at Marnie's)
~ Each type of food will get you somewhat different gifts from the birds.

[b][color=#e69138][size=3]Feathers[/size][/color][/b]
~ The most common gift from the birds.
~ Comes in[b] 9 different colors[/b], of [b]varying rarity and value[/b].
~ Counts as an [b]Animal Product[/b], so [b]Rancher [/b]will increase their value!
~ Certain feathers can be crafted into a decorative[b] Dream Catcher[/b]. Recipe for it sold at Robin's!

[b][color=#e69138][size=3]Config[/size][/color][/b]
~The [b]amount [/b]of birds that a Bird Feeder can spawn is configurable in the [b]config [/b]file.
By default, it's [b]2-4 birds per feeder[/b], and [b]12 max[/b] birds on the farm.
~"Doves" can also be enabled. This gives them a chance to spawn in the off-chance you've... done the [b]thing[/b].
Warning for that though: Doves don't really have a 'sandbox' animation, so they can look weird hopping around.

[b][color=#e69138][size=3]Recommendations[/size][/color][/b]
HIGHLY recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39616]Em's Wild Critters[/url]! Just the cutest little bird retexture!

[size=3][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI
Content Patcher

Downloads.Description: A lightly desaturated recolor of the bird feeders. Looks nicer with recolors like Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn. Overwrite the main file.
Adds various bird feeders to attract little birds to your farm.

Manifest.Description: Spawns birbs around my Bird Feeders.
